fact: The minister said the Cyber Security Act, passed in 2025 and signed into law, establishes the National Cybersecurity Authority for oversight, coordination and policy direction across sectors; commencement was expected by April 2026.
The minister said the Act formally strengthened the mandate of the National Computer Security Incident Response team, stated as existing at the 25 February 2026 cyber drill.
The Botswana Communications Regulatory Authority's notice on the Cybersecurity Bill refers to a Botswana National Cybersecurity Strategy that the Bill is meant to implement.
The BOCRA annual report 2025 says Botswana's national CSIRT sits inside BOCRA, was established in 2020 and is funded from the Authority's own resources.

The Botswana National CSIRT, through BOCRA, issued a public urgent advisory on the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), stating that exploitation attempts had been observed and urging organisations to patch and report suspected compromise to it.
